testRunner_comment: One warm Vitest instance per worker that runs only the tests covering each mutant; its projects come from the root vite.config.ts. It runs under Bun (see test:mutation) because the server tests need it.
plugins_comment: Bun's isolated install hides the runner from Stryker's plugin discovery, so it is named explicitly.
timeoutMS_comment: Static mutants rerun the whole suite, and the per-test timing Stryker budgets from leaves out per-file environment setup. The default 5s flips some of them to false timeouts under load.
incremental_comment: Reuses reports/stryker-incremental.json and retests only mutants whose code or covering tests changed. Pass --force for a full run.
mutate_comment: Only runtime source. Build scripts, vite configs and test helpers have no tests of their own, so mutating them only adds survivors.
ignorePatterns_comment: These decide what Stryker copies into its sandbox. `target/**` is the Rust build directory; without it every run duplicates gigabytes.
